items.idiom: have a conversation with someone you do not know
items.example: Do you enjoy having a conversation with someone you do not know?
We both love films, so we have a lot in common.
Good conversations work best when people take turns.
Do you ever gossip about celebrities with your friends?
He is good at telling jokes at parties.
Looking at your phone all the time will kill the conversation.
When it gets quiet, you can change the topic with a new question.
